title: The integers are a G-ring
statement: The ring $\mathbf Z$ is a G-ring [def-weil-pbc-g-ring] (Stacks Project, More on Algebra, Proposition Tag 07PX, item (3)).

source.place: More on Algebra, Proposition 07PX (tag 07PX, label proposition-ubiquity-G-ring, line 12652), item (3), https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07PX; the proof states that the claim for $\mathbf Z$ follows from the definition and the fact that the completion of a discrete valuation ring is a discrete valuation ring. Proposition 07PX separately cites Proposition 07PS (tag 07PS) for its complete-local-ring item (2).
